evals.prompt: 帮我给这篇论文做个卡片，文件在 ~/docs/papers/iclr2020-geom-gcn-pei/
evals.expected_output: Generate both card.md (quick) and card-deep.md (deep) from the acquired paper.
expectations: The skill reads metadata.yaml and paper/paper.md from the folder
Two subagents are dispatched in parallel: structure extractor and evaluation extractor
card.md is generated using the quick card template
card-deep.md is generated using the deep card template
Both files contain YAML frontmatter with title, authors, year, venue
The cards include extracted sections like problem, method, results, limitations

evals.prompt: 帮我深度分析一下 Attention Is All You Need 这篇论文，做个结构化拆解
evals.expected_output: Generate card-deep.md with detailed claim verification and evidence analysis.
expectations: The skill resolves the paper reference to a folder_slug first if needed
card-deep.md includes novelty assessment with star ratings
card-deep.md includes claim verification with evidence quality analysis
card-deep.md includes soundness and reproducibility assessment
The output references specific sections and page numbers from the paper

evals.prompt: 帮我总结一下 ~/docs/papers/xxx/ 这篇论文
evals.expected_output: Generate card.md as a quick summary card.
expectations: The skill checks for metadata.yaml and paper/paper.md prerequisites
If prerequisites are missing, the skill tells the user to run paper-acquire first
If prerequisites exist, card.md is generated with problem, method, key results
The card includes a one-paragraph executive summary at the top
